task_title: Icon batch generation pipeline (CLI + GH Actions + canvas)

plan_review.notes: 5 blocking concerns found: (1) brief generators emitted variantCount (not a schema field) and did not set generation.sheet.emptyCells for partial batches; (2) approveIconBatch index mapping unsafe if pipeline drops cells; (3) approval bypassed quality gates - hard-block gate added in approveIconBatch matching approveVariant contract; (4) runtime lookup model gap - documented in handoff as consumer-side follow-on; (5) issue body parsing used raw contains() checks instead of form-markdown parsing. All 5 blocking concerns addressed. Plan divergence: minor - no re-architecture, only bug fixes to existing design.

rounds.notes: PR review found 12 issues; all resolved: exact count-match guard (both directions), icon-batch-publisher CI authorization, rethrow in CI for queue failures, canonical ability registry (getAllAbilityDefinitions), shell injection via env: mapping + kebab validation, generate-briefs persistence via commit+push, per-cell brief-match instructions for judge, local-a1111 icon type support, run-all skips fully-approved batches, tests for approveIconBatch. Hard-block gate was resolved in round 1 (a44f77ea); review ledger updated to reflect.
